hook.name: LendingHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing an on-chain lending protocol integrated with pool price data. On afterInitialize it records the starting tick. On afterSwap it compares the pool price against a Chainlink oracle and, if within deviation bounds, identifies under-collateralized borrow positions and liquidates them by executing a nested swap inside the pool manager to absorb collateral.
